plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for RELIANOID load balancer. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for RELIANOID ADC (enterprise PEN 61269).
name: Loadbalance

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.query: avg(device_cpu_usage{instance_type='loadbalance', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or (100 - avg(device_cpu_idle{instance_type='loadbalance', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) or (avg(device_cpu_user{instance_type='loadbalance', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) + avg(device_cpu_system{instance_type='loadbalance', __$labels__}) by (instance_id))
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilization of the RELIANOID load balancer from UCD-SNMP ssCpuIdle (100 minus idle), falling back to ssCpuUser plus ssCpuSystem when idle is absent.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total real memory of the RELIANOID load balancer (UCD-SNMP memTotalReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free real memory of the RELIANOID load balancer (UCD-SNMP memAvailReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used real memory of the RELIANOID load balancer, derived as memTotalReal minus memAvailReal and converted from kB to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Real memory utilization of the RELIANOID load balancer, derived as (memTotalReal - memAvailReal) / memTotalReal * 100.

metrics.name: device_load1
metrics.description: Optional 1-minute load average of the RELIANOID load balancer (UCD-SNMP laLoad.1).

metrics.name: device_load5
metrics.description: Optional 5-minute load average of the RELIANOID load balancer (UCD-SNMP laLoad.2).

metrics.name: device_load15
metrics.description: Optional 15-minute load average of the RELIANOID load balancer (UCD-SNMP laLoad.3).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.
